name: which-is-my-gpt
description: Training-cutoff detector with a local Codex evaluation dashboard

scripts.check: node --check server.mjs && node --check dashboard.js && node --check scripts/run-codex-eval.mjs && node --check lib/updates.mjs
scripts.test: npm run check && node -e "const r=require('./app.js').selfTest(); if (!r.every(([, ok]) => ok)) process.exit(1); console.log(r.length + ' self-tests passed')" && node --test test/*.test.mjs
scripts.pm2:start: node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('.wimgpt',{recursive:true})" && pm2 startOrRestart ecosystem.config.cjs --only wimgpt-dashboard && pm2 save
